# CDC MPOX TREATMENT WITH TPOXX

# Eligibility:

o Consent: Must have documented consent by patient or legally authorized
representative in paper or i-Med consent
o Primary/empiric treatment: Confirmed diagnosis or suspected infection based
on exposure and/or symptoms while testing is pending.

o Secondary Treatment: Complications from replication competent vaccinia
infection from vaccination, secondary transmission, or other exposure. TPOXX may
be used after VIGIV treatment or in conjunction with VIGIV and/or with other
therapies based on clinical judgement.

o Post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP): May be considered on a case-by-case basis in
consultation with the CDC. Eligibility for PEP use depends on high risk exposure
confirmed or probable case and alternative or complement to PEP vaccination
is needed based on clinical judgment (e.g. vaccine allergy, immunocompromise).

o Dosage and duration: Weight based dosing for 14 days. But it may be longer
based on clinical progress but not to exceed 90 days. Oral tecovirimat capsule
should be taken by mouth with a full glass of water within 30 minutes after
eating a full meal of moderate or high fat (ideally about 600 calories and 25
grams of fat).

o CDC Case Reports Forms:  To be completed and returned to CDC by treating
physicians per IND protocol.

[CLICK HERE for link to required documents \(MPox Taskforce Teams group\)](orz-gtx-abx-tpoxx-documents-link)

# Exclusions:

o Patient or legally authorized representative unwilling to sign an informed
consent and refuse tecovirimat treatment
o  Known allergy to tecovirimat and/or excipients of tecovirimat
o  Upon negative test results for orthopoxvirus whose treatment was initiated
based on clinical manifestations prior to laboratory results.

o For IV tecovirimat only: patients with severe renal impairment (creatinine
clearance <30 mL/min)

# Oral Treatment:

Patients 40kg to < 120 kg
[INV-Tecovirimat 600 mg \(3 capsules\) orally q12h for 14 days](orz-set-abx-inv-tecovirimat-600-mg-orally-q12h-14-days)

*Places medication orders for inpatient and outpatient (included in order set)

Patients 120 kg and Above
[INV-Tecovirimat 600 mg \(3 capsules\) orally q8h for 14 days](orz-set-abx-inv-tecovirimat-600-mg-orally-q8h-14-days)

*Places medication orders for inpatient and outpatient (included in order set)

# Intravenous Treatment:

o Very ill hospitalized patients who are unable to take oral therapy or for whom
there is a concern that oral drug absorption may be altered.

o IV tecovirimat should not be administered in patients with severe renal
impairment (creatinine clearance <30 mL/min) and should be used with caution in
patients with moderate (creatinine clearance 30-49 mL/min) or mild (creatinine
clearance 50-80 mL/min) renal impairment.

o IV tecovirimat should be switched to the oral formulation as soon as patients
can take oral medications and/or gastrointestinal disfunction impacting
absorption has resolved.

Patients 35 kg to < 120 kg
[INV-Tecovirimat 200 mg IV q12h over 6 hours for 14 days](orz-set-abx-inv-tecovirimat-200mg-iv-q12h-x14-days)

*Places medication orders for 2 seperate INV-tecovirimat IV 100mg q12h orders
for a total of 400 mg over 24hrs via slow infusion.

Patients 120 kg and Above
[INV-Tecovirimat 300 mg IV q12h over 6 hours for 14 days](orz-set-abx-inv-tecovirimat-300mg-iv-q12h-x14-days)

*Places medication orders for 2 seperate INV-tecovirimat IV 150 mg q12h orders
for a total of 600 mg over 24hrs via slow infusion.
Inpt: ORZID2 GMENU ABX TPOXX MONKEYPOX TREATMENT
